standards: Only evaluation conditions/task-set/metric/aggregation determine Setting identity
Training budgets and model recipe remain evidence on Result Reports
No removed or guessed canonical results, first-public dates or scientific claims
Only explicitly verified official links published
A reported-baseline is not presented as independent reproduction
Case studies are accessible but not represented as official shared leaderboards
limitations: Only 12 verified official entry points are registered. Many heterogeneous paper tables remain author-reported; protocol grouping, even with compatible labels, does not establish training fairness, independent replication or complete leaderboards. Full original evidence remains in per-paper records.
